title:
O, Milly Bloom, you are my darling.
 You are my lookingglass from night to morning.
 I’d rather have you without a farthing
html_source:
‘As Stephen and Bloom will be blended together by the end of the novel, so Molly and Milly will merge as sirens, sex symbols, and all the other paraphernalia associated with the composite female image’ (Musical Allusions in the Works of James Joyce: Early Poetry through Ulysses, page 86).
